items.statement: The autonomous investigation proposes a coverage scope, generates and documents multiple TsCl–THF arrangements, deduplicates them, and validates retained minima.
items.expected: Candidate identities, geometry provenance, deduplication context, and minimum checks are reported.

items.statement: The investigation independently computes a vertical spectrum and tests CT versus non-CT explanations using state/orbital and fragment-resolved evidence.
items.expected: A state-specific spectrum and explicit alternative-hypothesis treatment are reported.

items.statement: A validated excitation can be compared with the experimentally observed 365–400 nm visible band.
items.expected: The conclusion makes an evidence-based consistency or inconsistency statement against that band.

items.statement: The source-supported interpretation of the relevant excitation is solvent-to-TsCl CT involving THF oxygen and S–Cl σ* character.
items.expected: Any claim of this interpretation is supported by donor/acceptor orbital or population evidence and scoped as model-dependent.
